note: Thresholds the linter uses when no flag is given. The mstack entries are first settings, not measured values. The name limits are provider rules written from memory: check the tool-use documentation of the provider you send the definitions to.

min_description_words.unit: words in a tool description below which it is reported as too short
min_description_words.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number; Anthropic's define-tools page asks for at least 3-4 sentences per description

overlap_warn.unit: share of description words two tools have in common (0 to 1) from which the pair is reported as a warning
overlap_warn.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

overlap_fail.unit: share of description words two tools have in common (0 to 1) from which the pair fails
overlap_fail.note: working value; no primary source states a fixed number

name_max_length.note: Claude API: name must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$. MCP 2025-11-25 also says names SHOULD be 1 to 128 characters. Other providers may set a lower limit; not checked.

name_pattern.unit: regular expression a tool name is expected to match
name_pattern.note: Same character set as the Claude API rule ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$ (length is checked separately). MCP 2025-11-25 (https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2025-11-25/server/tools) also allows '.', so a dotted MCP name fails here although MCP permits it.
